legend.title: You're {title}, aren't you? I'd know you anywhere.
{title}, here in {settlement}! Wait till I tell the others.

legend.title.text: So you're {title}. Smaller than the songs make you.
{title}! Oh, may I shake your hand?
Are you really {title}? My da told me about you!
{title}. I'd heard you'd come this way.

legend.mythic: You're the one they talk of. {mythic}, they call it.
I've heard the tale: {mythic}. Was it really you?

legend.mythic.text: {mythic}. They'll sing of that long after we're gone.
Folk say you're the one behind {mythic}. I'll believe it when I see it.

legend.hero: Look who it is. A hero walks among us.
Welcome, welcome! Folk have been talking about you.

legend.hero.text: A hero in {settlement}! Mind the mud, my lord.
Are you the hero? You are, aren't you!
